{{Top|leg}}
'''Motion trips''' were a specialized form of [[sensor trip]] that used an automated [[Motion sensor/Legends|motion sensor]]. They detected movement, and were best installed inside buildings and installations where there was less chance of them being accidentally triggered by weather conditions or passing wildlife. [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] manufactured the [[MoveSense 34 Motion Trip]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="ROE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>
